semantics.catalogOnlyRule: Rows with missing or physically unusable source orbital parameters remain catalog-only. This includes zero-altitude package reconstruction rows that cannot satisfy Orbit Studio's above-Earth two-body invariant.
semantics.orbitShape: GCAT canonical perigee, apogee, and inclination
semantics.partialPeriodReconciliation: The raw 2026 yearly table has two additional interval-anomaly/future-end rows. The package contract requires snapshot_present_earth_objects for the latest public view, so those rows remain excluded from partial-2026 membership.
semantics.primaryTimelineQuestion: present_at_period_end for completed years; snapshot_present_earth_objects for the partial 2026 package snapshot
semantics.reconstructionEpoch: The selected annual period end anchors the reconstructed phase.
semantics.snapshotPresent: No recorded GCAT descent/end date; not operational or live status.
